title: Photo: a man standing before the Dome of the Rock
summary: A photograph of a smiling man standing on the paved Temple Mount platform in Jerusalem in front of the golden Dome of the Rock.

pictures.description: A smiling man with glasses in a light sweater, with a jacket tied around his waist, stands on the stone-paved Temple Mount esplanade in front of the Dome of the Rock with its gold dome and blue-and-white tiled walls; a minaret, a small domed pavilion and a few visitors, including a man in a keffiyeh with a cane, are in the background under a grey sky.
